αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’

αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’

αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)

γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)

γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. (ἡμιόνων γένος ’the breed of mules’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of αἰσχυνέμεν: ’the stock (of the fathers)’
γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. inf. mid.: ’to come about, be made’ · also with περί + gen.: ’to be superior to’ · also aor. inf. mid. after φημί, predicate: ’to be, to have become’ · also aor. inf. mid. after δότε, acc. subject and predicate: ’that he become’ (δότε … γενέσθαι ’grant that he become’) · also aor. inf. mid. after ἔλπομαι: ’to have been born’ (ἐν Σαλαμῖνι γενέσθαι ’to have been born on Salamis’)
γλαφυρῇσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δάμεν: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδάμησαν): ’were subdued’, i.e. slain
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαμέντες: δάμνημι — tame, subdue, overpower; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl. (ἐδάμην): ’having been subdued, overcome’
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δεδήει: δαίω — burn, blaze; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. δέδηα, intrans.): ’was ablaze’
δειδιότες: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic δειδιότες (= Attic δεδιότες): ’dreading’, + acc.
δεκάτῳ: δέκατος — tenth; neut. dat. sg., with ἔτει understood: ’in the tenth (year)’
δηΐων: δήϊος — hostile; as noun, an enemy; masc. gen. pl., epic δηΐων (= Attic δηίων)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
δούρατα: δόρυ — spear (also beam, timber); neut. nom./acc. pl. δούρατα, epic stem δουρατ- (= Attic δόρατα): ’spears’
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’heavenly’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’)
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’they laid, stowed’
θείη: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α)
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)

θηρευτῇσι: θηρευτής — hunter, hunting (of dogs); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
θοὰς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας: ’swift (ships)’
θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
θωρηχθέντες: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., with reflexive sense: ’having armed themselves’
θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
κάππεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg. κάππεσον, with κατά assimilated to the next consonant (= κατέπεσον): ’I fell down’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’
καλλίρροον: καλλίρροος — fair-flowing, with a beautiful stream; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλλίρρουν), agreeing with ὕδωρ
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε)

κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)

κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg.

μάστιγι: μάστιξ — whip, lash; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with the whip’

μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μήνι: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε)
μήστωρα: μήστωρ — deviser, planner (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’
μενοιτίου: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, father of Patroclus; masc. gen. sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.

νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)

νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)

πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπε): ’sent, was sending’
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)

πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
πεζοὶ: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl., used as a noun: ’men on foot’
πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περάαν: περάω — pass through, cross; pres. inf., epic περάαν with vowel stretched (diectasis) (= Attic περᾶν)

πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολλὴν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κομιδήν: ’great’
πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’ (πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ’through the great throng’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον: ’much (toil)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄμβρον: ’a great (rain)’
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρυλέες: πρυλέες — foot-soldiers, men fighting on foot (plural noun; origin not certain); masc. nom. pl.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πύργων: πύργος — tower, wall-tower; masc. gen. pl., after ἐπιβήσεαι (+ gen.) · also masc. gen. pl., after ἐπί: ’on the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on ὅμαδος and δοῦπος: ’of towers being struck’
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
σιμόεις: Σιμόεις — the Simois, a river of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
σκάμανδρος: Σκάμανδρος — the Scamander, a river of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στίχες: στίξ — rank, line of men; fem. nom. pl.
στόματ: στόμα — mouth; neut. nom. pl., elided (στόματ’ = στόματα)
σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., epic acc. pl. σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by κατά: κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)

ταρφέα: ταρφύς — thick, close-set, frequent; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -έα

τείχεα: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τείχη)

ἠϊόνα: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡγεμόνεσσιν: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -όσι)
ἡνιόχῳ: ἡνίοχος — charioteer; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό: ’under the charioteer’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person charged after ἐπιτέλλω: ’to the charioteer’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἤλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. 3 pl., epic · also ’drove (a ditch), dug’ (τάφρον ἤλασαν ’drove a ditch’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδαίων: Ἰδαῖος — of Ida, Idaean; adj. gen. pl., agreeing with ὀρέων
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱππεῦσι: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. dat. pl. (= ἱππεῦσιν)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’
ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set up, station; impf. act. 3 pl., transitive: ’were drawing up’ (contrast intransitive mid. ἵσταντο)
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλέθρου: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. gen. sg., depending on πείραθ(α): ’of destruction’
ὀξέες: ὀξύς — sharp; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖς)
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after the word it follows (anastrophe): ’above’
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκύποδες: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’)
ῥέα: ῥέα — easily; adv., epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως, ῥεῖα)
ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
